{{Quote|Face Gang. Keep out. Blood toll.|Trig Longo's guess at the translation of Delphanian graffiti on the prison barge ''Purge''|<ref name="DT" />}}
The '''Delphanians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] noted for their scaly, [[Claw/Legends|claw]]-like [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and bellows-shaped [[Nose/Legends|noses]]. They came from the [[Delphania system/Legends|Delphania system]], where they noted various tribal identities by [[Piercing/Legends|piercing]] their protuberant lips. Delphanians sometimes added extra piercings after defeating a rival; in combat, their hands became dangerous slashing [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. Delphanians were among the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] kept aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. Some of these imprisoned Delphanians formed the [[Delphanian Face Gang]], headed at one point by the gang member [[Aur Myss]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Get your meat hooks back inside.|Wembly, a guard on the prison barge ''Purge'', ordering Aur Myss to release a prisoner the Delphanian had grabbed from another cell|<ref name="DT" />}}
The Delphanians were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species<ref name="DT" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|hailing]] from<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Delphania system/Legends|Delphania system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> At the front of the Delphanian [[Bone/Legends|skull]], the [[Species/Legends|species]]' face featured a [[Nose/Legends|nose]] that resembled a flattened, fuzzy bellows; a chin; and flabby lips around the [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. Delphanians had [[Limb/Legends|feet]] and were quick runners. At the end of their limbs, Delphanians had scaly hands that looked like broad, flat [[Claw/Legends|claws]]. They could use these to grasp objects or make a fist, but these manipulators doubled as deadly slashing [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] in combat. Some Delphanians had a rotund physique.<ref name="DT" />

==Society and culture==
The Delphanians divided themselves into various tribes, membership in which was indicated by metal lip [[Piercing/Legends|piercings]]. The Delphanian [[Aur Myss]] added new piercings whenever he defeated a rival; the conglomeration jangled when he spoke. Delphanian laughter sounded like a hiss or plash to other species. At least some Delphanians could understand and speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], although they had their own [[Language/Legends|language]], known as [[Delphanian language|Delphanian]], which they could read and [[Writing/Legends|write]]. An injured Delphanian screeched in pain, and an amused one giggled. At least some Delphanians wore [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="DT" />

==Delphanians in the galaxy==
{{Quote|I requested a transfer just so I could be close to you. Greased the right wheels, you might say. The second they open these doors, I'm going to rip you and your brother apart with my bare hands. And that's just for starters.|Aur Myss, to his rivals, Trig and Kale Longo|<ref name="DT" />}}
By [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Death Troopers]]'' to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> several Delphanians were [[Prison/Legends|incarcerated]] aboard the Imperial [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']], where some of them joined the [[Delphanian Face Gang]].<ref name="DT" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC" /> Aur Myss had risen to become the leader of the group. Myss's face boasted a perpetual, cockeyed smirk, although other [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] disagreed as to whether it was a genetic flaw or the result of an accident. Delphanian thugs followed Myss about the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Myss eventually came down with a sickness, and when he frantically attacked the [[Human/Legends|Human]] brothers [[Trig Longo|Trig]] and [[Kale Longo]], the latter [[Death/Legends|killed]] him with a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] to the back of the skull. Myss's body became reanimated as a [[Zombie/Legends|zombie]] sometime later and followed the brothers onto the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']]. When this undead Delphanian attacked Trig, the Human leapt into a chasm. A [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|hovercraft]] saved the Human, but the Delphanian zombie fell into the abyss.<ref name="DT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Delphanians appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'', written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="DT" />
